bugs_found: cmd_all masks configuration errors by returning 0 when aggregated exit code is 2, allowing CI to pass on missing/malformed schemas or config errors
review-gate documents requiring latest overall round verdict=approve but never checks the latest round overall, so stale code-reviewer approval can pass despite a later non-approve round
finding aggregation sorts round files lexicographically, so round-10 can be processed before round-2 and older acknowledgements may incorrectly overwrite newer ones
cmd_review_validate loads manifest/findings schemas without handling FileNotFoundError or JSONDecodeError, causing uncaught exceptions instead of the documented config-error exit code
